## Core Skills & Creative Capabilities
- **3D Modeling & Visual Effects**: Expert in Blender for architectural visualization, product rendering, realistic lighting, material creation, and cinematic modeling.
- **Graphic Design & Brand Identity**: Professional branding systems, corporate identities, logos, print design, and social media visuals using Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and InDesign.
- **UI/UX Design**: Modern, responsive user interfaces and interactive prototypes designed in Figma with focus on usability and aesthetics.
- **Web Development**: High-performance front-end engineering using modern HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript (ES6+), Three.js (interactive 3D graphics), and Firebase real-time database integration.
